ModMetaData.name: Local Tweaks (sammael)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Personal XML tweaks. Same list as the README on GitHub. - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients: decorative pneumatic tubes in vaults can be deconstructed (launch port and termini left alone). - Cyanobot's Plant Gen Patches + Biomes! Oasis: drops RG_Plant_JoshuaTree / RG_Plant_WingCactus from biome wild plants while ReGrowth 2 keeps those defs commented out. - Consistent Text: restores the Alpha Animals refinery recipe label (AA_ExtractUranium) its patch deletes. - Alpha Genes + Cherry Picker: removes the cherry-picked AG_DecreasedCommandRange gene from the random-mutation blacklist. - Flourish - Everyday Animations + Show Me Your Tools: children's floor drawing without Flourish's extra hands and body-lowering track. - Show Me Your Tools: no floating handheld spyglass while using a telescope (kept for skygazing). - Hauler's Dream: batch crafting gets the same Flourish animations and Show Me Your Tools tools as a normal bill. - Alpha Biomes + Vanilla Landmarks Expanded: chocolate and jadeite rock can be designated with "Mine vein". - Gulden Biome (Continued): capricorns butcher into vanilla horse meat, so "horse meat" no longer shows twice. - Biomes! Caverns: only one "nogtyl" in the plant menu (the cave copy is no longer sowable). - Vanilla Furniture Expanded: the ergonomic chair can be placed over existing chairs and stools to replace them. - Hospitality: Casino + Det's Xenotypes - Boglegs + VFE Settlers: the tongo, billiards and faro tables are casino equipment like the poker table (pricing gizmo, earnings; guests pay per game, faro through Casino's own poker driver). - Blueprints - 1.7 Waylith + Better Architect Menu / Loading Screen Repository: Blueprints tab nested under Colony and the blueprint loading tip, as those mods do for the old Blueprints fork. - Core + VFE Tribals: hoopstone ring, Game of Ur board and floor painting stay buildable after the colony advances past Neolithic. - MSS Flavour Pack: the exorcism operation costs 10 gold as described, not 100.
